title: soumikchandra-ai/LegalRAG
summary: LegalRAG是一个基于LangChain构建的检索增强生成系统，允许用户与上传的Legal PDF文件进行聊天，并通过自然语言提问获取相关答案。该系统利用模型进行训练和推理，支持向量索引和缓存机制，适用于法律文档的问答场景。
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation(RAG) system built with LangChain that allows users to chat with the the uploaded Legal PDFs and ask natural language questions and get relevant answers from the document.
